name: com.xkdlabs.simpledatalogs
description: Track events from Unity games and apps and see them as counters and charts on simpledatalogs.com. Crash-safe disk outbox, batching, retries and opt-in autocapture of launches, sessions, scene views and errors. No dependencies; works with IL2CPP and WebGL.

samples.description: Configures the SDK at launch and tracks level, purchase and tutorial events.
